2.88.9 Chart.ChartBorderSkin
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.ChartBorderSkin element specifies the border skin of a Chart. The
Chart.ChartBorderSkin element is optional. This element is of type ChartBorderSkin.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ChartBorderSkin element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ChartBorderSkin element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartBorderSkin" type="ChartBorderSkinType" minOccurs="0" />
